A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ActionVLM research. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–B support reliable comparison, including matching material across pagination and subsection renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original ActionVLM results on THUMOS14, ActivityNet-1.3, and EPIC-Kitchens-100, alongside ablations, efficiency measurements, and visual-ambiguity analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains those original empirical results and adds a description-granularity experiment in Appendix A.7 and Table 10.

M1.justification: The special tokens, alternating-epoch language-advantage estimation, residual aggregation, detection head, and losses remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 and Equations 1–9 are retained. The new description variants are ablation settings; the default full-description method remains intact.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three datasets, including EPIC-Kitchens verb/noun tasks and the 40 ambiguous THUMOS14 clips. The new description-granularity study varies inputs within the existing THUMOS14 task without expanding dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–9 is unchanged, including AdaTAD, ViT-TAD, DyFADet, ActionFormer, VTimeLLM, and TimeMarker in their corresponding comparisons. Table 10 introduces description ablations within ActionVLM, not additional external comparison methods.

E3.justification: Appendix A.7 adds three-word keyword descriptions and descriptions merged across similar actions as evaluation settings. Section 4.2 also changes the stated VLM version from InternVL3 to InternVL2.5, although the following sentence still names InternVL3. This is a reported configuration revision; the PDFs do not establish a backbone replacement or experimental rerun.

E4.justification: New Appendix A.7/Table 10 tests sensitivity to description granularity and token budget using keywords-only and merged-description variants. This extends the existing description-removal ablation with a focused analysis of how much linguistic detail is needed. Earlier analyses remain intact.

E5.justification: Point-estimate reporting remains unchanged, with no added run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, dispersion estimates, or significance tests. The expanded Ethics Statement recommends future uncertainty reporting but does not supply statistical uncertainty for the experiments.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain identical results. New Table 10 reports 71.0 mAP for keywords-only descriptions using 219 tokens and 71.9 for merged descriptions using 659 tokens. It repeats the existing 70.7 no-description and 72.0 full-model results, additionally reporting 742 tokens for the full descriptions.

T1.justification: The language-advantage definition, estimator, weighting function, aggregation equations, and objectives are unchanged. Expanded discussion of shortcuts and the vision-only reference explains existing mathematics without adding formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The central contributions and headline claim of up to 3.2% mAP improvement remain unchanged. The rewritten conclusion emphasizes complementing visual scaling, an argument already present in v1 Appendix A.7, without establishing a new core contribution.

C2.justification: V2 interprets Table 10 as showing that coherent action semantics matter more than preserving every class-specific phrase, and argues that video-dominated runtime favors retaining full descriptions. The Ethics Statement adds specific surveillance/profiling risks and a boundary against high-stakes use.

D1.justification: V2 adds a code-repository link, rules for constructing mismatched descriptions, and operational hallucination-detection details. Appendix A.3 newly specifies GPT-4o-mini for EPIC-Kitchens descriptions, with 78 verb classes/1,283 tokens and 211 noun classes/2,277 tokens. These are added disclosures, not evidence that the retained experiments changed.

R1.justification: The reference list is unchanged. Relationships to vision-only TAL, temporal-grounding VLMs, and prior debiasing approaches remain substantively the same; small wording edits do not redefine novelty or research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 makes targeted rewrites and expansions in Sections 3.3 and 4.3, the conclusion, Ethics Statement, and Appendix A.3. It inserts Appendix A.7, renumbers subsequent subsections, and updates author information, while retaining the overall organization and most prose.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 10, enlarges Figure 4, and adjusts table sizing, placement, and surrounding pagination. The six existing figures retain their image content, and existing table contents remain unchanged. These are localized presentation changes.

improvement.justification: Table 10 adds useful evidence about description-detail tradeoffs, while Section 4.3 and Appendix A.3 make the existing diagnostics and EPIC-Kitchens setup more reproducible. These provide limited gains with unchanged main results. The inconsistent InternVL2.5/InternVL3 labeling leaves a configuration ambiguity, but does not outweigh the added evidence and documentation.
